author: km-arc
name: Naravel application
description: A Naravel web application: routing, events, queue, mail, cache and database configured with one file per module, a welcome page, a health check and a test project that uses the fakes. By default it needs no database server, no Redis and no broker; --database, --cache, --queue and --mail choose other drivers.

NaravelVersion.description: The version of the Naravel packages the application references. The default is the version of this template pack.

AppRootNamespace.description: The name given with -n, made safe to use as a C# namespace (my-blog becomes my_blog, 1st becomes _1st). The C# files, RootNamespace and the cache key prefix use this.

AppProjectName.description: The name given with -n, exactly as it was given: the name of the project file and of the tests folder, which a path inside a file has to repeat. The engine writes a safe form (my_blog) for sourceName inside a file, so a path must not use sourceName.

database.description: The database driver. The package, the registration lines and config/database.json follow the choice.

choices.description: A SQLite file under storage/. Needs no server.
No database: the Database packages, their registration and config/database.json are left out.

queue.description: The queue driver. The worker runs inside the application for every choice.

choices.description: Files under storage/queue. Needs no broker.
In process: jobs are lost when the application stops.
Writes the message to the application log and delivers nothing.
Sends through an SMTP server (Naravel.Mail.Smtp). The host in config/mail.json is a placeholder.

NeedsService.value: (database == "postgres" || database == "mysql" || database == "sqlserver" || cache == "redis" || queue == "redis" || queue == "rabbitmq" || queue == "kafka" || mail == "smtp")
